user.title: CampChef Integration Setup
user.description: Enter your CampChef account email address. You will receive a 6-digit PIN code via email.

pin.title: Enter PIN Code
pin.description: Check your inbox and spam folder for the 6-digit PIN sent to {email}. Enter the newest code below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CampChef
reauth_confirm.description: Your CampChef session has expired. Continue to send a new PIN to {email}.

error.invalid_email: CampChef rejected the email address or the PIN request.
error.invalid_pin: Invalid PIN code. Please check your email and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to CampChef servers. Please check your internet connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This CampChef account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The PIN was verified for a different CampChef account. Sign in with the account already connected to this integration.
